payload.title: PyPI README links to repo-relative docs/VS_BEADS.md and AGENTS.md, which 404 on PyPI
payload.description:
**Problem**
Relative links in the PyPI long description resolve against pypi.org, not the repo, so they are dead on the package page.

**Evidence**
- python/README.md:30 and :121 link to relative `docs/VS_BEADS.md` and `AGENTS.md`.

**Fix**
Use absolute GitHub URLs (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/blob/main/docs/VS_BEADS.md and .../AGENTS.md) in python/README.md.

**How to verify**
`grep -nE '\]\((docs/|AGENTS.md)' python/README.md` returns nothing; on the next PyPI release the links open the GitHub files.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
